pages.title: TAMU HOSA | Future Health Professionals
pages.metaDescription: TAMU HOSA is the Texas A&M chapter of HOSA - Future Health Professionals, empowering members to become leaders in the global health community.

sections.heading: Future Health Professionals
sections.lede: HOSA (Future Health Professionals) empowers members to become leaders in the global health community through education, collaboration, and experience.

sections.title: A Pre-Health Community at Texas A&M
sections.lede: TAMU HOSA connects pre-health students through competitive events, service, and community — building the skills and network needed for a career in healthcare.

cards.title: Competitions
cards.body: Test your knowledge and skills at state and international HOSA competitive events across dozens of health-science categories.

cards.title: Membership
cards.body: General meetings, dues, member points, and everything you need to get involved with the chapter.

cards.title: Community Service
cards.body: Give back through service projects like our NMDP marrow-registry drive and other community health initiatives.

sections.title: Ready to Join?
sections.lede: Whether you're aiming for competition or just want a pre-health community, there's a place for you in TAMU HOSA.

pages.title: NMDP Service Project | TAMU HOSA
pages.metaDescription: TAMU HOSA partners with the National Marrow Donor Program (NMDP) to host bone marrow registry drives on the Texas A&M campus.

sections.heading: NMDP Service Project
sections.lede: Partnering with the National Marrow Donor Program to save lives.

sections.title: What Is NMDP?
sections.lede: The National Marrow Donor Program (NMDP) connects patients with life-saving bone marrow and blood stem cell donors. TAMU HOSA partners with NMDP to host registry drives on campus.
sections.note: Next NMDP drive date TBD — check back for updates.

cards.title: Join the Registry
cards.body: Placeholder: eligible students can join the donor registry with a simple cheek swab at our drives.

cards.title: Help Run a Drive
cards.body: Placeholder: members can earn service hours and points by volunteering at NMDP registry events.

cards.title: Spread Awareness
cards.body: Placeholder: help educate the campus community about the impact of the bone marrow registry.
